name: CUIControlTextDisplay::Render
needs: ours also wrong: the exe takes renderLock.Lock(INFINITE) after the m_nRenderCount block (exe 0x4e32bb) and unlocks on the early-return path (exe 0x4e33ad) and on the BKUnlock-failure path (exe 0x4e33b6); ours has neither the Lock nor either Unlock. The critical section is the instance member field_A8E (the fork renames the same member to s_csSharedList, implying a static that does not exist in the exe). The fork's added m_posTopString/m_plstStrings null check has no counterpart after BKLock in the exe. Fix: add renderLock.Lock(INFINITE) after the m_nRenderCount block, add renderLock.Unlock() on both early-return paths, keep field_A8E as the critical section, and do not add the null check.
